integrity: The proof uses the preferential-attachment growth coupling, a deterministic degree-weighted-depth identity for trees, and exact first-moment recurrences. A standalone exact-rational checker independently enumerates all weighted parent histories through size nine and checks the closed-form and recurrence identities through size three hundred. The finite replay is supplementary rather than an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact formulas use the single-edge seed and zero-offset linear preferential attachment.
Total root-to-vertex path length is not the same statistic as average pairwise path length.
Negative covariance does not imply stochastic ordering or negative association.
title: Root-hub bias exactly reduces global depth in the Barabási–Albert tree
